contract.camera: 3/4, 45deg steps, elev 40deg (shared with the fleet, houses, characters, fuel kit)
contract.origin: ground-centre of each piece’s own footprint
contract.axes: +x, +y as authored per piece; +z up. Storefront front is +y.
contract.oneRule: A station is a LIST OF GRADE POSITIONS. Valance stripes, boot cups, sign rows and apron fill caps are all generated from it — nothing is drawn twice.
contract.grades: imported by reference from FuelIso; stove oil is added here
contract.hose: never baked — StationIso.serve() returns a polyline plus honest metres
contract.placement: StationIso.plan(cfg) lays a forecourt out in metres; sortPieces() orders it far-to-near on the rasteriser’s own depth
contract.reachPoint: TESTED, not requested: every point is checked against its own piece’s blockers and its claimed surface, marched clear if it fails, and published as null with a reason if nothing inside arm’s reach works. Cross-piece placement is still the caller’s problem.
